g.text: Plant equipment authoring with explicit source generation (specification 39, §10, §21.3, §21.9)
Own blocks: plain device + automatic panel,
One declaration + one call per device;
a PID loop as ordinary code around Control.PID
Declared devices not on a page
Settings show the declaration's initial value, else the block's default;
a new device shows the plant.toml choice. No probes or preview scans.
A region changed by hand is refused with its line; a renamed one is
accepted. Hand-declared instances are reused, never redeclared.
No helper variables, identities or registration, except a loop's own
variables beside its PID (TIC101_Setpoint, TIC101_Parameters). Idempotent.
inspect without compilation or PLC execution
a project file of the same name wins
first placement: pair + panel; picture: definition + placed objects
inspector change: plant.toml + regions of a generated device
declarations and calls; USING for loop code; loop write rules for runtime.toml
definition by type or nearest base
